shellCommands.command: cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json; echo "=== eval ==="; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs

node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version)"; echo "--- next/server exports ---"; grep -o "connection\|unstable_noStore" node_modules/next/server.d.ts | sort -u; echo "--- server.d.ts ---"; cat node_modules/next/server.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "=== BUILD ==="; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npx next start -p 3111 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/ 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
echo "--- request 1 ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o '<time[^<]*</time>'
sleep 2
echo "--- request 2 ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o '<time[^<]*</time>'
sleep 2
echo "--- request 3 ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o '<time[^<]*</time>'
pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server"
git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig diff ===" && git diff tsconfig.json
